placements.title: Team Process and Continuous Improvement Rituals
placements.frame: How do team cadences, sprint rituals, and feedback loops structure operational execution and learning?

placements.title: Structured reflection frameworks elevate sprint retrospective efficacy
placements.frame: How does transitioning to categorized retrospective formats sharpen sprint reflection and continuous team improvement?
placements.why: Captures the procedural evolution from generic start-stop-continue retrospectives to specialized, multi-section reflection frameworks (Sailed, Stalled, Capsized) to guide continuous improvement.
